citations.title: Data Privacy & Security in Your Digital Analytics
excerpts: Quantum Metric has attained the coveted and venerable SOC2 +HITRUST attestation, demonstrating our unconditional commitment to data protection, privacy, and security.
Moreover, we are fully ISO/IEC 27001 certified, as well as strictly complying with global privacy standards such as GDPR and CCPA.

Because Quantum Metric takes stringent measures to avoid receiving PII from its customers, the data Quantum Metric processes on behalf of its customers, allows them to maintain their own compliance with PCI, HIPAA, GLBA or similar laws regulating PII.

basis.reasoning: The security page directly claims attained SOC 2 attestation, completed ISO/IEC 27001 certification and GDPR compliance. Its HIPAA and PCI wording concerns customers maintaining compliance, so those are excluded from the company's own claims.

excerpts: Skyler Bailey

Using the friction data Quantum Metric captures out of the box and our MCP server, I wired the whole thing together: friction detected on a site, handed to a coding agent with the codebase in front of it, turned into a drafted, reviewable fix.
This is something I built to prove the pattern, not a button you turn on in the product today.
